_comment: Provider template — FILENAME=ROUTE (qwen-token-plan-cn: the credential+endpoint channel; token var derives from it). `_family` = MODEL LINEAGE (qwen) — the same/different-family judgment unit (model-routing.md). `model` = the pinned per-generation id, never part of the filename. Route: the Alibaba Token Plan SUBSCRIPTION channel — a MULTI-FAMILY route (serves qwen/glm/deepseek/kimi under one key); _family names the PINNED MODEL's lineage (qwen), not the route. For the pay-per-use DashScope channel use qwen-bailian.json. EXAMPLE of a user-authored provider extension: copy this file to profiles/<name>.json, set routing + <UPPERCASE-NAME>_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (convention; override via `_token_env`); no code change. See install.md. ADR #40. Sanitized copy of parallel-development's profiles/qwen-token-plan-cn.json (CSR-I3 substrate — rule 7 copy-pattern).
